我们的两位内阁成员，[discordant_council_leader_1.GetTitle][discordant_council_leader_1.GetName]和[discordant_council_leader_2.GetTitle][discordant_council_leader_2.GetName]近来发现他们的占星结果相冲。

texts.en:
Two of our council members, [discordant_council_leader_1.GetTitle] [discordant_council_leader_1.GetName] and [discordant_council_leader_2.GetTitle] [discordant_council_leader_2.GetName] recently learned that their astrological signs are diametrically incompatible.
